assessments.reasoning: The instrument mentions family care responsibilities only as a reason for working part-time (QC29) or for not seeking work (QF07), and mentions 'Casalinga/o' as a self-perceived status category (QJ01). Per the operational instructions, care given as a reason for not working or for not working more hours does not count. The questionnaire does not contain any question asking whether a person supervises or remains available to care for household members while engaged in other activities.
